record.label: Abandoned G11B CP4-cap validation panel
record.summary: The larger G11B cap panel was invalidated before launch by board #328616. The immutable abort records zero target-free calls, no target columns, no output directories, and no submission. Cap science moved to an independently preregistered plain-D1 panel.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed only for caps stacked on failed G11B. Its distinct direct-D1 successor P2R0C1D12 is separately closed by disjoint16 measurement.
